sentences.text: The keystone of good academic writing is deliberate structure, and a seminar room can serve as a haven where every student may practise without fear.

sentences.text: A mediocre presentation without original insight can rarely impress an audience, and people who attend a lecture only sporadically may miss the cumulative logic of a course, so a student should practise every week without fail.

lessonGrammar.name: 名词短语作主语
lessonGrammar.note: The keystone of good academic writing 是一个以 of 连接的复杂名词短语,作句子的主语,这是学术写作的典型表达。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: The keystone of good academic writing is deliberate structure, and a seminar room can serve as a haven where every student may practise without fear.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 优秀学术写作的关键在于深思熟虑的结构,而研讨室可以成为每个学生自由练习的避风港。

lessonGrammar.name: and 连接并列句
lessonGrammar.note: and 连接两个并列分句,使论述逻辑清晰,是学术写作中常用的并列结构。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: The keystone of good academic writing is deliberate structure, and a seminar room can serve as a haven where every student may practise without fear.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 优秀学术写作的关键在于深思熟虑的结构,而研讨室可以成为每个学生自由练习的避风港。

lessonGrammar.name: where 引导定语从句
lessonGrammar.note: where 引导的定语从句修饰 haven,表示"在这里学生可以练习"。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: The keystone of good academic writing is deliberate structure, and a seminar room can serve as a haven where every student may practise without fear.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 优秀学术写作的关键在于深思熟虑的结构,而研讨室可以成为每个学生自由练习的避风港。

lessonGrammar.name: 表语从句
lessonGrammar.note: is 后面的 that 从句作表语,说明主语的内容,是学术写作中下定义、表观点的重要句式。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: A common fallacy in first-year writing is that a long sentence alone can express style, whereas clarity and logic matter far more, a truth that every tutorial can reinforce.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 一年级写作中常见的谬论是:长句本身就能体现文采,而实际上清晰与逻辑重要得多,这一事实是每次辅导课都应强化的。

lessonGrammar.name: whereas 表示对比
lessonGrammar.note: whereas 引导对比关系,相当于"而",用于论证中对比两种观点。
